rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Social Enterprise Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Social Enterprise Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 9 (Application for Certification) ① Any person who intends to obtain certification as a social enterprise pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Social Enterprise Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)shall submit an application for social enterprise certification in the form of Annex No. 1, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs necessary for the certification examination, to the head of the Korea Social Enterprise Promotion Agency (hereinafter referred to as the “Agency”) pursuant to Article 20 of the Act (including submission via mail or fax, or submission of electronic documents via information and communications networks). <Amended July 17, 2015>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Application for Certification) ① Any person who intends to obtain certification as a social enterprise pursuant to Article 7(1) of the Social Enterprise Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall submit an application for social enterprise certification in the form of Annex No. 1, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs necessary for the certification examination, to the head of the Korea Social Enterprise Promotion Agency (hereinafter referred to as the “Agency”) pursuant to Article 20 of the Act (including submission via mail or fax, or submission of electronic documents via information and communications networks). <Amended July 17, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. Documents confirming that the organization has the organizational form pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act
rows.text_en: 1. Documents confirming that the organization has the organizational form pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. Register of paid workers pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act
rows.text_en: 2. Register of paid workers pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 3. The following documents capable of verifying whether the criteria for determining the realization of social purposes pursuant to Article 9 of the Enforcement Decree of the Social Enterprise Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) are satisfied
rows.text_en: 3. The following documents capable of verifying whether the criteria for determining the realization of social purposes pursuant to Article 9 of the Enforcement Decree of the Social Enterprise Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) are satisfied

rows.source_ko: a. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Fact as a Social Service Provision Type Social Enterprise ( Form No. 2) and supporting documents confirming status as a vulnerable group pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, such as a copy of the Certificate of Registration of Persons with Disabilities (to be submitted only if applicable).
rows.text_en: a. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Fact as a Social Service Provision Type Social Enterprise ( Form No. 2) and supporting documents confirming status as a vulnerable group pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, such as a copy of the Certificate of Registration of Persons with Disabilities (to be submitted only if applicable).

rows.source_ko: B. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Facts as a Job-Providing Social Enterprise ( Form No. 3) and supporting documents confirming status as a vulnerable group pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, such as a copy of the Certificate of Registration of Persons with Disabilities (to be submitted only if applicable)
rows.text_en: B. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Facts as a Job-Providing Social Enterprise ( Form No. 3) and supporting documents confirming status as a vulnerable group pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, such as a copy of the Certificate of Registration of Persons with Disabilities (to be submitted only if applicable)

rows.source_ko: C. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Facts as a Community-Contributing Social Enterprise (Form No. 4) and supporting documents confirming local vulnerable status (to be submitted only if applicable)
rows.text_en: C. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Facts as a Community-Contributing Social Enterprise (Form No. 4) and supporting documents confirming local vulnerable status (to be submitted only if applicable)

rows.source_ko: D. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Facts as a Mixed-Type Social Enterprise ( Form No. 5) and supporting documents confirming status as a vulnerable group pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, such as a copy of the Certificate of Registration of Persons with Disabilities (to be submitted only if applicable).
rows.text_en: D. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Facts as a Mixed-Type Social Enterprise ( Form No. 5) and supporting documents confirming status as a vulnerable group pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, such as a copy of the Certificate of Registration of Persons with Disabilities (to be submitted only if applicable).

rows.source_ko: 마. 영 제9조제2항의 경우: 별지 제6호서식의 기타형 사회적기업 사실확인서와, 사업위탁계약서 사본 등 사회적 목적 실현 여부를 확인할 수 있는 구비서류(해당하는 경우에만 제출한다)
rows.text_en: E. In the case of Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree : Confirmation of Facts for Other Types of Social Enterprise (Form No. 6 ) and supporting documents verifying the realization of social objectives, such as a copy of the business consignment contract (to be submitted only if applicable).

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제8조제1항제4호에 따른 이해관계자가 참여하는 의사결정 구조를 갖추고 있음을 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents confirming that a decision-making structure involving stakeholders pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act is in place

rows.source_ko: 5. 법 제8조제1항제5호 및 영 제10조에 따른 영업활동을 통한 수입기준의 충족 여부를 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 5. Documents verifying whether the income criteria through business activities pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 5 of the Act and Article 10 of the Enforcement Decree are satisfied

rows.source_ko: 6. 법 제8조제1항제6호에 따른 정관이나 규약 등의 사본
rows.text_en: 6. A copy of the articles of incorporation or bylaws, etc. pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 6 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 7. 중앙행정기관이나 지방자치단체로부터 시설비, 창업자금, 운영경비 등을 지원받거나 지원받을 예정인 경우에는 그 지원 사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류(해당하는 경우에만 제출한다)
rows.text_en: 7. If facility costs, startup funds, operating expenses, etc. are received or are scheduled to be received from a central administrative agency or a local government, documents verifying such support (submit only if applicable)

rows.source_ko: ② 진흥원의 장은 제1항에 따라 사회적기업 인증 신청서를 받으면 제1항 각 호에 따른 서류를 갖추었는지를 조사ㆍ확인하여야 하며, 구비서류가 다 갖추어지지 아니한 경우에는 보완하도록 요구할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② When the head of the Promotion Agency receives an application for social enterprise certification pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall investigate and verify whether the documents required under each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 have been prepared, and if the required documents are not all prepared, he/she may request supplementation.

rows.source_ko: ③ 진흥원의 장은 제2항에 따른 조사ㆍ확인이 끝나면 제1항에 따른 사회적기업 인증 신청서를 지체 없이 고용노동부장관에게 송부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the Promotion Agency shall, upon completion of the investigation and verification pursuant to Paragraph 2, send the application for social enterprise certification pursuant to Paragraph 1 to the Minister of Employment and Labor without delay.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(인증서의 발급) 고용노동부장관은 제9조제3항에 따라 사회적기업 인증 신청서를 받으면 제12조에 따른 인증 신청기간 종료일부터 60일 이내에 「고용정책 기본법」 제10조에 따른 고용정책심의회의 심의를 거쳐 사회적기업으로 적합하다고 인정하는 경우에는 그 신청인에게 별지 제7호서식의 사회적기업 인증서를 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Issuance of Certificate) When the Minister of Employment and Laborreceives an application for social enterprise certification pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 3, if the applicant is recognized as suitable as a social enterprise after deliberation by the Employment Policy Deliberation Council pursuant to Article 10 of the Framework Act on Employment Policy within 60 days from the end of the application period pursuant to Article 12, the Minister shall issue a social enterprise certificate in the form of Annex 7 to the applicant
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(인증서의 재발급) ① 사회적기업이 기관명이나 대표자 등의 변경으로 사회적기업 인증서를 재발급받아야 할 필요가 있는 경우에는 별지 제8호서식의 사회적기업 인증서 재발급 신청서에 사회적기업 인증서 및 관련 증명서류를 첨부하여 진흥원의 장에게 신청하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Reissuance of Certificate) ① If a social enterprise needs to have its social enterprise certificate reissued due to a change in the name of the organization or the representative, etc.,it must apply to the head of the Promotion Agency by attaching the social enterprise certificate and related supporting documents to the application for reissuance of the social enterprise certificate in the form of Annex 8 .

rows.source_ko: ② 진흥원의 장은 제1항에 따라 사회적기업 인증서 재발급 신청서를 받으면 구비서류를 갖추었는지를 조사ㆍ확인하여야 하며, 구비서류가 다 갖추어지지 아니한 경우에는 보완하도록 요구할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② When the head of the Promotion Agency receives an application for the reissuance of a social enterprise certificate pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall investigate and verify whether the required documents have been prepared, and if the required documents are not all prepared, he/she may request supplementation.

rows.source_ko: ③ 진흥원의 장은 제2항에 따른 조사ㆍ확인이 끝나면 제1항에 따른 사회적기업 인증서 재발급 신청서를 지체 없이 고용노동부장관에게 송부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Once the investigation and verification under paragraph 2 are completed, the head of the Promotion Agency shall send the application for reissuance of the social enterprise certificate under paragraph 1 to the Minister of Employment and Labor without delay.

rows.source_ko: ④ 고용노동부장관은 제3항에 따라 사회적기업 인증서 재발급 신청서를 받으면 제1항에 따른 신청일부터 14일 이내에 사회적기업 인증서를 재발급하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ④ Upon receiving an application for reissuance of a social enterprise certificate pursuant to Paragraph 3, the Minister of Employment and Labor shall reissue the social enterprise certificate within 14 days from the date of application pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Amended July 17, 2015>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(인증의 신청 및 신청기간 등의 공고) 고용노동부장관은 사회적기업의 인증 신청 및 인증 신청기간 등에 관한 사항을 연 1회 이상 공고하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Publication of Application for Certification and Application Period, etc.) The Minister of Employment and Labor shall publish matters concerning the application for certification of social enterprises and the application period, etc. at least once a year. <Amended July 12, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(재정 지원 대상의 선정 요건) ① 법 제14조제3항에 따라 재정 지원의 대상이 되는 사회적기업은 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 충족하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Selection Requirements for Financial Support Recipients) ①A social enterprise eligible for financial support pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall satisfy all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 사회적기업의 조직 형태가 법 제8조제1항제1호 또는 영 제8조에 따른 비영리법인 또는 단체일 것
rows.text_en: 1. The organizational form of the social enterprise must be a non-profit corporation or organization pursuant to Article 8 , Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act or Article 8 of the Enforcement Decree.

rows.source_ko: 2. 중앙행정기관 및 지방자치단체로부터 동일하거나 유사한 재정 지원을 받고 있지 아니할 것
rows.text_en: 2. It shall not be receiving identical or similar financial support from central administrative agencies or local governments.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 사회적기업의 조직 형태가 법 제8조제1항제1호에 따른 「상법」상 회사로서 해당 회사로부터 사회서비스를 제공받는 사람 중 취약계층의 비율, 해당 회사의 전체 근로자 중 취약계층의 고용비율 또는 해당 회사의 지역사회 공헌 내용 등이 고용노동부장관이 정하여 고시하는 요건을 충족하는 경우에는 법 제14조제1항에 따른 재정 지원을 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if the organizational form of a social enterprise is a company under the Commercial Act pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act , and the ratio of vulnerable groups among those receiving social services from the company, the employment ratio of vulnerable groups among the company's total employees, or the company's contribution to the local community satisfies the requirements determined and notified by the Minister of Employment and Labor, financial support may be provided pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(재정지원 계획의 공고) 고용노동부장관은 해당 연도의 예산을 고려하여 사회적기업에 대한 재정지원 계획을 매년 공고하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Publication of Financial Support Plan) The Minister of Employment and Labor shall publicly announce a financial support plan for social enterprises annually, taking into consideration the budget for the relevant year. <Amended July 12, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(재정 지원의 신청 등) ① 법 제14조제1항에 따라 재정 지원을 받으려는 사회적기업은 별지 제9호서식의 사회적기업 지원금 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 지방고용노동관서의 장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Application for Financial Support, etc.) ①A social enterprise seeking financial support pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the head of the local employment and labor office an application for social enterprise support funds in the form of Annex 9 , attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 사회적기업 인증서 사본
rows.text_en: 1. Copy of Social Enterprise Certification

rows.source_ko: 2. 근로자 명부
rows.text_en: 2. Worker Register

rows.source_ko: 3. 거래은행 통장 사본
rows.text_en: 3. Copy of transaction bank passbook

rows.source_ko: 4. 사업계획서(지원금 신청 내역을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Business plan (including details of the grant application)

rows.source_ko: ② 지방고용노동관서의 장은 재정 지원 대상자 선정을 위한 심사위원회를 구성하여 대상자와 지원금액을 결정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the local employment and labor office shall form a review committee to select recipients of financial support and determine the recipients and the amount of support.

rows.source_ko: ③ 지방고용노동관서의 장은 재정 지원 대상자와 지원금액을 결정한 경우에는 해당 사회적기업의 대표자, 관계 중앙행정기관의 장 또는 지방자치단체의 장에게 그 결과를 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the head of a local employment and labor office determines the recipients of financial support and the amount of support, he/she shall notify the representative of the relevant social enterprise, the head of the relevant central administrative agency, or the head of the local government of the results.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제16조(사업보고서 기재 사항) ①법 제17조제1항 전단에서 “이해관계자의 의사결정 참여 내용 등 고용노동부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Matters to be Included in Business Reports) ① The phrase “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Employment and Labor, such as details of the participation of stakeholders in decision-making” in the first part of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 취약계층에 대한 사회서비스 또는 일자리의 제공, 지역사회 공헌 내용 등 전년도의 사업 추진 실적 및 해당 연도의 사업계획
rows.text_en: 1. Previous year's project implementation results and current year's project plan, including the provision of social services or jobs for vulnerable groups and contributions to the local community

rows.source_ko: 2. 수입ㆍ지출 등 회계에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning accounting, such as income and expenditure

rows.source_ko: 3. 이해관계자의 의사결정 참여 내용
rows.text_en: 3. Details of Stakeholder Participation in Decision-Making

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제17조제1항에 따라 사회적기업은 별지 제10호서식의 사업보고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 지방고용노동관서의 장에게 제출(정보통신망을 이용한 전자문서의 제출을 포함한다)하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 7. 17., 2017. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act , a social enterprise shall submit a business report in the form of Annex 10 , attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the head of the local employment and labor office (including the submission of electronic documents via information and communications networks). <Amended July 17, 2015; March 24, 2017>
1. Deleted <December 20, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 2. 유급근로자 명부
rows.text_en: 2. Register of Paid Workers

rows.source_ko: 3. 전년도 및 전전년도의 재무제표 사본(매 회계연도 4월 30일까지 제출하는 경우에만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Copies of financial statements for the previous and the year before last (only applicable if submitted by April 30 of each fiscal year)

rows.source_ko: 4. 금년도 사업계획서(매 회계연도 4월 30일까지 제출하는 경우에만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Business plan for this year (applicable only if submitted by April 30 of each fiscal year)

rows.source_ko: 5. 정관 사본(정관을 변경한 경우에만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Copy of Articles of Incorporation (only applicable if the Articles of Incorporation have been amended)

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 사업보고서를 제출받은 지방고용노동관서의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따라 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 사업자등록증을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 사회적기업이 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다. <신설 2017. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the regional employment and labor office who receives a business report pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall verify the business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information in accordance with Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the social enterprise does not consent to the verification, it shall be required to attach the relevant documents. <Newly added Mar. 24, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제16조의2(사업보고서의 공표방법) 고용노동부장관은 법 제17조제1항 후단에 따라 사회적기업이 제출한 사업보고서를 고용노동부, 고용센터 및 진흥원의 홈페이지 등에 공표할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 16-2 (Method of Publication of Business Reports) Pursuant to the latter part of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Minister of Employment and Labormay publish business reports submitted by social enterprises on the websites of the Ministry of Employment and Labor, employment centers, and the Promotion Agency, etc.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(인증취소의 세부 절차) ① 지방고용노동관서의 장이 법 제18조제3항에 따라 청문을 하려는 경우에는 청문의 일시와 장소를 적은 출석 요구서를 사회적기업 인증취소의 대상이 되는 사회적기업의 대표자에게 송부하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Detailed Procedures for Revocation of Certification) ① Where the head of a regional employment and labor office intends to hold a hearing pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she shall send a summons to appear, specifying the date and place of the hearing, to the representative of the social enterprise subject to the revocation of social enterprise certification. <Amended July 17, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 청문 출석 요구서를 받은 사회적기업의 대표자가 지정된 일시에 부득이한 사유로 출석할 수 없는 경우에는 그 일시를 조정할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If the representative of a social enterprise who has received a summons to attend a hearing pursuant to Paragraph 1 is unable to attend at the designated time due to unavoidable circumstances, the time may be adjusted.

rows.source_ko: ③ 지방고용노동관서의 장이 법 제18조제1항에 따라 사회적기업의 인증을 취소하였을 때에는 지체 없이 그 사유를 명시하여 해당 사회적기업의 대표자, 관계 중앙행정기관의 장 또는 지방자치단체의 장, 진흥원의 장에게 알리고, 이를 관보에 게재하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 7. 17.>
rows.text_en: ③ When the head of a regional employment and labor office revokes the certification of a social enterprise pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall, without delay, notify the representative of the relevant social enterprise, the head of the relevant central administrative agency or local government, and the head of the Promotion Agency, specifying the reasons for such revocation, and shall publish the notice in the Official Gazette. <Amended July 17, 2015>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제18조(규제의 재검토) 고용노동부장관은 제16조에 따른 사업보고서 기재 사항에 대하여 2017년 1월 1일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 1월 1일 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 2. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Employment and Labor shall review the validity of matters stated in business reports pursuant to Article 16 every three years, starting from January 1, 2017 (meaning before January 1 of the year marking every third year), and take measures such as improvements. <Amended Feb. 3, 2017>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2014]
